as entries get .entries
from_entries @entries
as repeats get .repeats
from_entries @repeats
as none get .none
from_entries @none
as keyless get .keyless
from_entries @keyless
as not_maps get .not_maps
from_entries @not_maps
as null_key get .null_key
from_entries @null_key
from_entries
as listed entries
from_entries @listed
